title: Catalog release quickstart visuals: onboarding + deprecation banners
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Produce a set of onboarding/quickstart screenshots and collateral for the model catalog release notes. Assets must cover: (1) new model tiles and short descriptors, (2) pricing callouts and per-token cost tooltip, (3) deprecation banners and migration guidance callout, (4) quickstart flow screenshots that live in the docs and in-app onboarding carousel, and (5) mobile/responsive variants. Deliverables will be used in release notes, product changelog, docs quickstart, and marketing email. Ensure designs follow Console visual system, meet contrast & accessibility standards, and include annotations for engineering QA and localization. Coordinate with PM for accurate model names and with Engineering for verified cost numbers and deprecation timeline.
acceptance_criteria: All screenshots exported in PNG @2x and SVG where applicable
Designs approved by PM and Product Marketing in the Figma review thread
Pricing copy matches final numbers from PM (PM-3990) and Eng confirms tooltip mapping (ENG-5987)
Deprecation banner variant includes migration CTA and links to migration guide (Confluence link in design_links)
Accessibility checklist passed (color contrast, alt text, keyboard focus state) and accessibility reviewer sign-off noted in comments
tasks: Draft initial Figma frames for desktop, tablet, mobile quickstart flows
Create pricing callout component and tooltip demo frames
Design deprecation banners with three severity states: notice, recommended, urgent
Annotate frames with copy, i18n length allowances, and export specs
Export assets and upload to Drive release folder; add links to release notes PR
Hand off to engineering with a component spec and QA checklist

Deprecation banner (in-app): three states (info/recommended/urgent) with CTA 'Migrate guide' and small dismiss link. Show both with and without CTA visible.
Quickstart flow: 3-step carousel screenshots (create key, call API snippet, view logs) with code highlight and copy button state.
Responsive variants: tablet landscape, mobile portrait with touch target overlay and accessible focus rings shown.
Localization preview: German and Japanese truncation examples for model tile names and pricing tooltip.
Dark-mode variants for hero and deprecation banners ensuring contrast parity.
